survey: A blue plastic sports bottle floating at a tilt against a sunburst background, with nothing wrong in how it is built. The cap is a ridged blue screw cap that sits flush on the bottle's neck, with a small rim where they meet. A short push-pull spout rises from the middle of the cap. A carry loop runs from the base of the spout, arcs out to the right and comes back to a round pivot knob on the side of the cap, so both ends attach. The body is one piece with a waist and two grip hollows, one on each side; they look slightly different only because of the angle, and they mirror each other. The flat base is closed and round. The bottle floats free, which is normal for a single-object card, and it doesn't touch or rest on anything. The water drops are surface droplets, not added parts. Nothing is invented, and nothing is missing or doubled. One cap, one spout and one loop are all things a real sports bottle has. The bottle could hold liquid, close and be carried.
